blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On All Souls’ Day, families of enforced disappearances (Desaparecidos) were urged to continue to fight for justice and carry on the causes their missing loved ones championed, even with no bodies or graves to visit. The families, together with members from the groups Desaparecidos Philippines, Karapatan, and Hustisya, gathered at Claret School in Quezon City for a Mass and a program as they offered prayers and flowers for their missing kin. “Kung nandito ang ating mga kaanak, alam natin lahat na sila ay hindi humihiwalay sa pakikibaka sa lansangan para igiit ang makatarungang sahod, para igiit ang lahat […]...
